mission: Build a local evidence base for the Teacher Mind so tutoring, accessibility, and support strategies are grounded in serious professional guidance rather than improvised assumptions.
storage_rule: Keep PDFs and large files outside Git; keep manifest metadata, local storage paths, and evidence notes in the repo.
collection_principles: Start with official practice guides, institutional frameworks, and high-credibility syntheses before collecting many individual studies.
Prefer sources that directly inform teaching decisions, accessibility choices, and support for mathematically relevant learning barriers.
Translate all evidence into bounded instructional implications rather than diagnosis claims.
Keep the Teacher Mind evidence corpus separate from the Mathematics Knowledge Core but interoperable with it.
Treat storage, provenance, and rights status as first-class metadata.

evidence_domains.name: Mathematics Intervention
evidence_domains.goal: Ground tutoring moves in evidence-based mathematics instruction for struggling learners.

evidence_domains.name: Universal Design and Accessibility
evidence_domains.goal: Support format choices that reduce barriers for a wide range of learners.

evidence_domains.name: Attention and Self-Regulation
evidence_domains.goal: Guide explanation pacing, chunking, and classroom-support style adjustments for learners with attention-related challenges.

evidence_domains.name: Learning Disabilities Overview
evidence_domains.goal: Provide careful, non-diagnostic grounding for dyslexia-, dysgraphia-, and dyscalculia-relevant support.

evidence_domains.name: Research Restraint
evidence_domains.goal: Ensure the tutor remains psychologically careful, non-overreaching, and dignity-preserving.

starter_sources.title: Assisting Students Struggling with Mathematics: Intervention in the Elementary Grades
starter_sources.organization: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Core evidence base for systematic math intervention, representations, mathematical language, number lines, word problems, and fluency support.

starter_sources.title: Improving Mathematical Problem Solving in Grades 4 Through 8
starter_sources.organization: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Important for visual representations, multiple solution strategies, mathematical notation, and reflective problem-solving support.

starter_sources.title: Teaching Math to Young Children
starter_sources.organization: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Grounds early math explanation, developmental progression, and formative monitoring for foundational number understanding.

starter_sources.title: Foundations for Success: The Final Report of the National Mathematics Advisory Panel
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Broad evidence-oriented synthesis on mathematics learning, algebra readiness, conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and instructional priorities.

starter_sources.title: CAST Universal Design for Learning Guidelines 3.0
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Primary accessibility framework for offering multiple means of engagement, representation, and action in learning design.

starter_sources.title: ADHD in the Classroom: Helping Children Succeed in School
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Authoritative classroom support reference for attention-related obstacles, accommodations, and evidence-aligned school support options.

starter_sources.title: Learning Disabilities
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Official overview for dyslexia, dysgraphia, and dyscalculia with careful non-stigmatizing definitions and signs.

starter_sources.title: Reading and Reading Disorders
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Useful grounding for dyslexia-adjacent support choices, reading load concerns, and non-diagnostic explanation design.

starter_sources.title: Infographic: Does your child struggle with Math? Dyscalculia could be the reason.
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Useful supplementary official framing for math-learning-disability language, signs, and public-facing explanation constraints.

starter_sources.title: Adventure Research Restraint Layer
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Carries forward non-diagnostic, dignity-preserving, anti-overreach rules that can anchor the Teacher Mind safety layer.
